story.description:
User Story: Login
As a registered user, I want to log in using my email and password so that I can access my account.
Acceptance Criteria:
User can enter an email and password.
User can submit the login form.
Valid credentials allow the user to log in successfully.
Invalid credentials display an appropriate error.
Required fields are validated when left empty.
